title: A Monsoon for the Wreck
premise: Kestrel Delacroix, a riverboat captain haunted by the crew he lost when he once stopped moving, hauls up a salvage chest bearing the seal of Veymar, a drowned nation whose concession permits expire in six tides. Racing a ruthless salvage fleet commanded by his former mentor, Kestrel gathers an unlikely found family — a disgraced cartographer, a stowaway diver, and his estranged deckhand niece — to reach the wreck first. At the wreck he discovers the chest was bait: the fleet's owner wants not treasure but the Veymar charter, a document that would legalize her claim over the entire river. In the climax, Kestrel chooses to sink the charter rather than sell it, losing the fortune but gaining a crew worth stopping for, and finally moors his boat at a town he might call home.
about_author: Yara Oyelaran is a former barge hand who spent seven years working the delta waterways before turning to fiction. She writes adventure novels about people who live on moving water, drawing on her love of river lore and the communities that form along its banks.

chapters.title: Six Tides
chapters.summary: Kestrel's POV. Running cargo upriver, Kestrel dredges a sealed chest stamped with Veymar's dead nation's seal; that night, fleet gunboats shadow him and his old mentor sends an offer he can't refuse — or survive refusing. He learns the permits expire in six tides. The beat is dread mixed with reluctant hunger: for the first time in years, something has made him want to stop.

chapters.title: The Cartographer's Debt
chapters.summary: Alternating POV between Kestrel and Odile, a disgraced imperial cartographer who owes him a life-debt. She reveals the wreck holds the Veymar charter, which would hand the river to whoever claims it. They recruit Tam, a stowaway diver, and Kestrel's estranged niece Sefa joins under protest. The emotional beat is wary trust — strangers becoming, against their will, a crew.

chapters.title: What the River Keeps
chapters.summary: Kestrel's POV. The fleet sabotages rival boats and takes Sefa hostage to force Kestrel's surrender of the chart. Kestrel trades his boat's engine for her freedom, stranding them all as the final tide turns. Navigating the last miles by pole and memory, they reach the flooded cathedral wreck. The beat is sacrifice: Kestrel gives up the mobility that defined him to protect his found family.

chapters.title: A Monsoon for the Wreck
chapters.summary: Kestrel's POV, with Sefa's coda. Inside the wreck, Kestrel confronts his mentor and the fleet's owner, who offers him everything he ever fled from — wealth, permanence, power. Instead he lets the monsoon storm breach the hull, drowning the charter forever. The fleet retreats; the crew survives on the riverbank. The beat is release: Kestrel moors the crippled boat at a river town and, for once, stays.
